task_description: Implement a comprehensive Alpha Validation / Alpha Effectiveness Evaluation module that evaluates whether a strategy/alpha is effective across 8 core dimensions: Return Ability, Risk-Adjusted Returns, Transaction Cost/Executability, Drawdown & Extreme Risk, Efficiency/Per-Unit Trade Quality, Independence/Correlation, Coverage/Applicability, and Robustness/Generalization. Provides an AlphaValidator class with multi-dimensional scoring and pass/fail system.

verification.summary: All 298 tests pass (267 original + 31 new). Example script runs correctly. High-quality alphas score >96, low-quality alphas score <47 - scoring system is discriminative. Review issues addressed.
